title: Welcome to Tobia — Jashu Port Complex
author: Port Authority Announcer
content: Welcome to Tobia, capital of the Trojan Reach. Please keep berthing transponders active, carry your Ident Chip, and comply with local scan requests. Grav cars and shuttles serve all Jashu districts and the Space Elevator terminal.

title: Planetary Summary
author: Civic Liaison
content: Type: Dry garden world (thin atmo, ~0.6G). Pop: ~23B (+2–3B orbit). Tech: TL15. Ocean coverage ~40%. Arcologies dominate; grav-floated neighborhoods common. Summer brings allergic fungal spores—masks recommended outdoors.

title: Starport System Overview
author: Port Authority
content: Highport (Star City): ~1.5B population; orbital governance; Navy fortress platforms; remote docking override mandated. Downport (Jashu): ground pads and mobile grav docking platforms; reconfigurable luxury bays; direct grav links to districts and the Space Elevator.

title: Space Elevator Schedule
author: Transit Directorate
content: Luxury capsule departures every 90 minutes. Standard ascent/descent ~12 hours. Cargo windows prioritized 03:00–05:00 and 17:00–19:00 local. Expect inspection at both termini.

title: Berthing & Fuel
author: Finance Subsystem
content: Berthing (Scout/Courier): 500 Cr/week baseline. Refined fuel premium during orbital festival cycles. Unrefined fuel available; skimming permits require Navy clearance. Late fees after 24h.

title: Ident & Manifest Compliance
author: Registry Clerk
content: Crew manifests must match the Imperial Registry. Jump-lag exists, but deep scans reconcile anomalies. Violations can result in berth suspension and bond seizure.

title: Cultural Bulletin — Jashu
author: Cultural Directorate
content: Arcology galleries feature First Imperium relics and modern kinetic architecture tours. Dress standards vary; formal wear expected in elevated grav neighborhoods and governmental halls.

title: Health Advisory: Summer Spores
author: Health Directorate
content: Thin atmosphere plus seasonal fungal spores may irritate lungs and eyes. Recommended: light masks, antihistamine tabs, and sealed grav transit for long cross-city trips.

title: Tobia Commerce Guild — Traffic Notice
author: TCG Port Liaison
content: High-volume freight pulses expected along the Aslan route. Escorts prioritized for megafreighters. Independent captains should register convoy interest 24h prior to departure.

title: Trade Irregularities (Flagged)
author: Customs AI Auditor
content: Pattern alerts triggered on neural-interface components and psionically shielded housings. Full details require elevated access.

roll_check.on_success: Cross-ref shows ambiguous lot numbers and micro-mesh Faraday liners routed through shell brokers. Recommend secondary scans; potential linkage to prior seizures.
roll_check.on_failure: Access denied. Submit Form T-221 for audit briefing.

title: Navy Advisory — Remote Docking Overrides
author: Highport Operations
content: All civilian vessels must maintain handshake readiness. Interlocks may trigger automatic course corrections during congestion or security actions. Override logic details restricted.

roll_check.on_success: Override windows open during scheduled convoy turns and military transits. Non-compliance flags vessels for enhanced inspection on next berth.
roll_check.on_failure: Insufficient clearance. Contact Highport Ops liaison.

title: Civic Services & Embassies
author: Civic Liaison
content: Embassy Row handles interstellar visas, notarizations, and arbitration. Merchant Guild offices provide manifests and bond services. Licensed fixers listed in the Blue Ledger registry.

title: Corporate Announcement — General Development Company
author: GeDeCo Directorate (Vorito Office)
content:
🌐 GeDeCo — Building Tomorrow, Today 🌐

• New starports and orbital infrastructure
• Technical training and long-term economic stability
• Trade access to the Imperium and beyond

Partner with GeDeCo, and your children will inherit a future of boundless opportunity. Our legacy spans four centuries — and continues to shape civilisation, one world at a time.
